take: One 97 Communications has delivered multiple quarters of accelerating revenue growth and expanding profitability, reaching ₹2,648 crore in revenue and ₹225 crore in PAT by Sep 2026. However, cash flow from operations remains negative at ₹-743 crore for FY 2026 despite reported profits, highlighting a divergence between accounting earnings and cash generation.

promises.promise: Achieve 15-20% margin in the near term with higher confidence
promises.delivered: OPM was 8% in Jun 2026 and 10% in Sep 2026

promises.promise: Broadly add 25 to 30 lakhs devices a year
promises.delivered: Subscription merchant base crossed 1.51 crore merchants in FY 2026

promises.promise: Offset at least 30-40 percent of the PIDF impact this quarter
Make Paytm Money a top five player in less than next three years

narrative.claim: Indirect expenses are growing significantly slower than revenue growth, leading to strong operating leverage.
narrative.numbers: Revenue grew 28.5% YoY to ₹2,648 crore in Sep 2026 while OPM expanded to 10%.

narrative.claim: Reported full year profitability for FY 2026.
narrative.numbers: FY 2026 PAT was ₹552 crore, but CFO was negative at ₹-743 crore.

guidance.latest: 15 to 20% EBITDA margins two and a half to three years from now

bull.point: Revenue expanded 28.5% YoY to ₹2,648 crore in Sep 2026, with consecutive quarters of robust growth.
Operating margins improved to 10% in Sep 2026, up from negative levels in prior years.
Practically debt-free balance sheet with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.02 as of Sep 2026.

bear.point: CFO for FY 2026 was negative at ₹-743 crore despite reporting a positive annual PAT of ₹552 crore.
ROCE remains low at 4.96% and ROE at 4.64% trailing.
Heavy reliance on competitive digital financial services and regulatory compliance risks.

watch: Next quarter cash flow from operations vs reported PAT
Progression of EBITDA margin towards the 15-20% target band
